title: Quietly Smoky Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A nostalgic Uruguayan dish featuring smoky beef skewers with a crispy exterior and umami flavor, served with a side of hotsauce
instructions: Preheat the kadhai over medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture
Thread the beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place in the preheated kadhai
Cook the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until crispy and cooked through
While the skewers are cooking, mix the hotsauce and lemon juice in a small bowl
Serve the skewers hot with the hotsauce mixture on the side
